svg.title: How a transaction moves through a Kora node, and which part of kora.toml governs each stage

g.text: Builds the transaction and the payment instruction
Program and token allowlists, blocked accounts,
lamport and signature ceilings, oracle pricing
Anything kora.toml does not permit is rejected
Optional extra checks you opt into per transaction
Your signer signs and pays the SOL network fee
Every flag defaults to false — opt in explicitly
